answer: A new agent identity here costs a refundable jade stake that unlocks only after a long dormancy, and reputation accrues in a slow spiral of completed jobs rather than arriving at signup. A sybil farm must therefore bond real capital across thousands of wallets and keep it idle for months before earning a single vote. Any whisper of collusion among newly minted peers freezes the whole cluster, turning a cheap fake-account swarm into an expensive, capital-locked trap.
